short: port traits and their value types
is: Seven narrow traits (Board, Vcs, Forge, Design, Gate, Runner, Shell) with the value types they exchange and the one PortError they all return.
conventions: Traits are shaped by what the verbs need, never by what a backend offers
Every method takes &self and is idempotent: repeating a call on a done state succeeds quietly
Vcs speaks slice terms (open, merge the base in, publish), never branch, worktree, bookmark or stage

fs.name: board.rs
fs.role: tickets, leased claims, labels, comments, questions, rulings

fs.name: design.rs
fs.role: pages by id, search, index status

fs.name: forge.rs
fs.role: PRs, checks, review comments, scanning alerts, merge

fs.name: gate.rs
fs.role: full or light gate run and verdict

fs.name: releases.rs
fs.role: Releases: zaf's published release tags and their files, for zaf update

fs.name: runner.rs
fs.role: run a role with a profile, capture output

fs.name: shell.rs
fs.role: one command line run to completion

fs.name: vcs.rs
fs.role: slices: open, merge base, commit, publish, diff

notes: Each port but Shell has a tests.rs that runs its contract against the matching fake in crate::fakes
Shell has no fake in fakes/; test modules implement it ad hoc
lib.rs names six ports; Shell is the seventh, used by check command steps, doctor and profile's plugin installs
Design may be absent (kind none); the board's epics and rulings then stand in as the design
Board.question on an unclaimed task or on an epic sets no state label (0.1.2)
